why: JUCE sends a component a mouseExit when the pointer moves onto one of its children, so a hover flag driven by the container's own mouseEnter/mouseExit clears whenever the pointer is over a slider, knob or button inside it, and whatever the hover governs (a preview, a highlight) vanishes. Hover on a container means the pointer is over the container or any child: read isMouseOver (true), or listen to the children with addMouseListener (this, true), decide it in one place, and repaint what it governs when it changes.
